newsitem.title: HONG KONG: RESEARCH ALERT-Hopewell HLdgs downgrade.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Hopewell HLdgs downgrade.

text.p: Goldman Sachs said it has downgraded its recommendation for Hopewell Holdings Ltd to market underperformer from market outperformer.

"Given the company's massive outstanding capital commitment, further funding will be hard to find and a rights issue seems the only viable alternative," said analyst Benjamin Cheng in a recent research note.

"In a couple of months, Hopewell will need HK$5.0 billion -HK$6.0 billion. Its current net debt to equity ratio stands at 33 percent with only HK$4 billion in cash retained on the parent level," the report said.
Cheng is forecasting earnings per share of HK$1.18 for the year ended June 1997 and HK$0.37 for June 1998.
At HK$4.00, the share was trading on a price earnings ratio of 3.4 times 1997 earnings and 10.9 times 1998.
The share closed HK$0.075 lower at HK$4.25 on Monday.
